title: Potato salad with smoked trout and dill
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 18–20 minutes, peel and slice them while warm.
Stir the yoghurt with mustard, lemon juice, salt, pepper and chopped dill.
Dice the cucumber, finely chop the onion and mix with the potatoes and dressing.
Flake the trout and arrange it with rocket on the salad.
